gloss: ready to eat; ripe for eating; at its best for eating

definitions.gloss: ready to eat; at peak ripeness; at its best for eating
definitions.explanation: The ideal state or timing for eating something, especially fruit or other produce that reaches peak flavor and texture at a certain point of ripeness.

examples.japanese: このバナナはちょうど{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}だ。
examples.english: This banana is just ready to eat.

examples.japanese: もう{少|すこ}し{置|お}いたら{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}になるよ。
examples.english: If you leave it a bit longer, it will be ready to eat.

examples.japanese: {桃|もも}は{柔|やわ}らかくなってきたら{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}のサインだ。
examples.english: When peaches start to soften, that's a sign they're ready to eat.

notes:
Composed of the verb stem {食|た}べ (to eat) and the suffix {頃|ごろ} (suitable time, peak). The suffix ～{頃|ごろ} attaches to verb stems to indicate the ideal time or condition for that action.

RELATED ～{頃|ごろ} WORDS:
- {見|み}{頃|ごろ}: at its best for viewing (flowers, scenery)
- {飲|の}み{頃|ごろ}: at its best for drinking (wine, tea)
- {読|よ}み{頃|ごろ}: good for reading; page count that's easy to finish
- {買|か}い{頃|ごろ}: good time to buy; reasonably priced

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}の{果物|くだもの}: fruit that is ripe and ready to eat
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}になる: to become ready to eat
- ちょうど{食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}: just at the right time for eating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旬|しゅん}: in season — focuses on seasonal availability rather than individual ripeness
- {熟|じゅく}した: ripe, mature — describes the state of the food itself
